account.passwordHint: After the change, all your other sessions are signed out.
account.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.description: Signing in also needs a one-time code from an authenticator app, so a stolen or guessed password is not enough.

enroll.scan: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enroll.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
enroll.manual: Cannot scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
enroll.enterCode: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.

confirmDisable.title: Turn off two-step verification?
confirmDisable.content: Your account will be protected by your password alone.

confirmRegenerate.title: Generate new recovery codes?
confirmRegenerate.content: Your current recovery codes will stop working.

security.recoveryHint: One-time codes for signing in without your authenticator app. Generating new ones makes the old ones stop working.

recoveryCodes.warning: If you lose access to your authenticator app, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only this time.
recoveryCodes.fileHeader: Cairn recovery codes for {username} on {host}. Each code can be used once.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Browsers and devices signed in to your account.
sessions.revokedOthers: Signed out {count} session. | Signed out {count} sessions.

confirmOthers.title: Sign out all other sessions?
confirmOthers.content: Every other browser signed in to your account will have to sign in again.

panel.defaultLocaleHint: Used on the sign-in page and for users who have not chosen a language.
panel.readOnly: Your role can view these settings but not change them.

stepUp.title: Re-authenticate for sensitive operations
stepUp.description: Opening a terminal, managing users, downloading backups and other sensitive operations ask for your password again; one confirmation lasts 10 minutes. API tokens can never perform them.
stepUp.offWarning: Re-authentication is off: anyone with a signed-in session can perform sensitive operations without entering the password.
stepUp.enabled: Sensitive operations ask for the password again.
stepUp.disabled: Sensitive operations no longer ask for the password.

appearance.themeHint: Saved to your account, so it is the same on every computer you sign in from. The sign-in page follows the system.
appearance.languageHint: Applies at once and is saved to your account. It only changes the panel for you.

panelCert.siteHost: {domains} is also a website's domain. Opened there, the panel shares its host name with that website: a browser sends the panel's cookies to it, whatever the port, and it can set cookies for the panel. The panel never accepts its cookies alone, but it is safer to give the panel a host name of its own, such as panel.example.com. | {domains} are also domains of websites. cloud.channelHint: Which releases the panel offers to install.
